items.statement: The investigation begins from the exact neutral singlet C18H12N2S2 structure and verifies identity and stereochemistry.
items.expected: Formula, atom count, charge, multiplicity, connectivity and E constraints are recorded and checked.

items.statement: The selected optimized state and spectral calculations are independently validated and limitations are recorded.
items.expected: Stationary-point evidence and a reproducible method/coverage record are present.

items.statement: The investigation reports the four named IR diagnostics with comparison reasoning.
items.expected: Each C-S, C=C, C=N and C-H assignment has a computed value and explicit comparison.

items.statement: The investigation reports two diagnostic UV-visible excitations and interprets their electronic character.
items.expected: Wavelength, oscillator strength, transition character and comparison are given for both bands.
